CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   C. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   B. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   B. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

11. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
